lines.text: Imagine one M C P token that can touch every project you have. Storefront, billing, search, all of it.
Tokens leak. They end up in a log, a pasted message, or a screenshot. And when that one leaks, everything leaks.
Worse, rotating that token breaks every agent at once. So people delay, and the risk just sits there.
Agent R Q scopes the key. Each workspace has its own M C P token, and nothing else.
An agent holding the storefront token sees the storefront, and nothing else. Billing is simply not there for it.
Now a leak stays in one workspace. The damage is limited to the project that token could ever reach.
So you rotate the one token, and the rest keep working. No outage, no scramble, no waiting for next week.
Adding an agent is easy. Give it the token for the one workspace it needs, and nothing more.
Each workspace keeps its own history, so you can see which calls came in on which token.
And the token is not a free pass. Sensitive tool calls still ask you first, inside that workspace.
You do not set this up. A new workspace gets its own token the moment you create it.
A small blast radius, by default. Try workspaces at Agent R Q dot com.
